## Scope check

`aq` is a thin control wrapper over `ogre` + the
Aquanode API — it orchestrates renting a box and provisioning the on-box agent. On-box
snapshot/restore behavior belongs in `ogre`. Does your request fit `aq`'s control role,
or is it really an `ogre` change?
